section.title: Jurisdiction and Venue
section.para: Claims arise under the First Amendment (federal constitutional), California Constitution Art. I §1 (privacy) and Art. I §2 (speech), and California Penal Code provisions governing sexual services. Federal constitutional claims invoke federal court jurisdiction; state constitutional claims can be heard in CA Superior Court.

Constitutional scope: Federal constitutional (1st Amendment, bodily autonomy doctrine post-Dobbs); California constitutional (Art. I §1 explicit privacy right, Art. I §2 broader speech). Lower courts cannot resolve these constitutional questions.
